description: Use this tool whenever a user asks for a complete 2025, 2026, or 2027 Form 1040 federal tax return estimate, how much room they have left in their current marginal tax bracket, how much Long-Term Capital Gains they can harvest at 0% federal tax, whether they will breach the 2026 ACA 400% FPL health insurance subsidy cliff (Form 8962), or how Social Security taxation (Line 6b), the OBBBA Schedule 1-A Senior Deduction (Line 13a), and Form 8995 QBI (Line 13b) flow through Form 1040.

filing.description: Federal tax filing status (single, mfj, hoh, or mfs).

iraDistributions.description: Form 1040 Line 4b Taxable IRA, 401(k), or RMD distributions in USD.

netLtcg.description: Form 1040 Line 7a Net Long-Term Capital Gain in USD.

qualifiedDividends.description: Form 1040 Line 3a Qualified Dividends in USD.

rothConversions.description: Form 1040 Line 4b Taxable Roth conversions in USD.

seniors65Plus.description: Number of taxpayers on the return age 65 or older (0, 1, or 2).

w2Wages.description: Form 1040 Line 1a W-2 wages in USD.

name: simulate_form_1040_and_bracket_room
title: Simulate 2026 Federal Form 1040 Return (Lines 1a-38), Remaining Bracket Room & ACA / 0% LTCG Ceilings
